question.worked_solution:
First, we convert the given probability into a cumulative probability:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<-1.5)=0.0526\,⇒\,P(X\le -1.5)=0.0526\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le -1.5) & =0.0526 \\ P(Z\le \frac{-1.5-\mu }{2.5}) & =0.0526 \\ Φ(\frac{-1.5-\mu }{2.5}) & =0.0526 \\ \frac{-1.5-\mu }{2.5} & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.0526)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(-1.62)=0.0526\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.0526)=-1.62.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{-1.5-\mu }{2.5} & =-1.62 \\ -1.5-\mu  & =-4.05 \\ \mu  & =2.55.\end{aligned}
$$
